result.title: The Answer Knows Where to Look: Zooming before MLLMs Answer under Visual-Token Budgets
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) read images through visual tokens, and under the small per-image budgets that efficient deployment requires, the fine text of documents, charts and infographics becomes illegible. Zooming in recovers the evidence, but the region must be chosen before the model answers. We find that MLLMs know where the evidence is, but not in a form that can be read before they answer: the answer tokens localize it from the middle layers on, whereas the attention available before answering does so only in the top layers, at a depth that varies across models, and diffusely. Supervising the pre-answer attention to point degrades reading, and the benefit of zooming is governed by each image's information gap. Building on these findings, we introduce ours, which lets an MLLM look where its answer would. A dedicated look token, processed in a single prefill and kept out of the answering pass, learns in hindsight to attend as the model's own correct answers do, extracting this knowledge into a concentrated pointer before any answer exists. Its hidden state then selects how to look, from no zoom to crops, square windows, windows that adapt to the pointer and foveated warps, supervised by the counterfactual outcome of every view. ours needs no box annotations, per-model layer search, external localizers or generation before the answer. On Qwen3-VL at three scales and five text-rich benchmarks, it surpasses the strongest baseline by 4.8-9.1 points at 98 visual tokens per view and attention-guided zooming by 11.1-17.0 points, while running faster than attention-guided and grounding-based zooming.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究小视觉 token 预算下 MLLM 如何在回答前选定放大区域：发现答案 token 自中层起已能定位证据，而预答注意力只在顶层、弥散且深度因模型而异，遂引入单个 look token，在单次预填充中以事后方式学习模仿模型自身正确答案的注意力，其隐状态据此在不放大、crop、方形窗、指针自适应窗与 foveated warp 间选择，并由各视图的反事实结果监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「先看再答」中的视觉证据筛选与 LOOK 决策：把预答内部状态当作指针来选择证据获取方式，其中「预答注意力无法直接读出证据位置」的诊断与信息坍缩、显式监督预答注意力反而损害阅读的负结果，以及反事实视图监督下的贡献分配，均值得优先核查。
